dataset_fit.unit_of_analysis: detailed occupation x six-digit generation industry x survey year cell
dataset_fit.population: wage and salary workers in U.S. electric power generation establishments (NAICS 221111-221117)
dataset_fit.sample_size_feasibility: about 2,075 detailed cells with published mean wages across 8 industries; about 1,850 in the 7 analytic industries; 1,500+ cells in occupation-years observed in more than one industry

codebook_validation.source_documentation: Field Descriptions sheet in each OEWS file (special codes *, **, #; top-code $100/hr in 2021, $115/hr in 2025) and BLS May 2025 technical notes
codebook_validation.checked_counts: annual-only cells 0; mean-wage '*' 0-8 per year; '#' mean 0-1 per year; employment '**' 8-20 per year; P90 '#' 26-40 per year 2021-2024 and 1 in 2025

dataset_design_review.design_notes: OEWS samples about 1.1 million establishments in six semiannual panels over three years; estimates are design-weighted and, since May 2021, produced with the MB3 model-based method. Published cells are aggregate estimates, not microdata. Cells repeat across years and industries for the same occupation.
dataset_design_review.analytic_decision: Treat each published cell as an observation; weight by estimated employment so results describe workers; cluster standard errors by detailed occupation because the same occupation appears across industries and years; use inverse-variance weights from MEAN_PRSE as robustness; do not interpret adjacent-year changes as independent because panels overlap.
accepted_limitations: No access to OEWS microdata, establishment identifiers, or strata; cannot model within-cell variation or the survey design directly
Overlapping three-year panel pooling induces serial dependence across releases
Suppressed cells (wage '*' or employment '**') are excluded, so the sample is the set of publishable cells
dataset_design_review.limitation_rationale: Only public aggregate tables are available; the chosen weighting and clustering are the standard approach for analyzing published OEWS cells, and the limitations are carried forward to scope language.

outcome_families.planned_model: employment-weighted least squares with fixed effects

outcome_families.outcome: log real 10th and 90th percentile hourly wage
outcome_families.family: continuous with right-censoring at the top code for P90
outcome_families.decision: harmonized censoring at $100 nominal; censored cells excluded and counted

outcome_family_screen.phase5_implication: No count/bounded/zero-inflated families; the model ladder varies fixed effects, weights, and samples rather than outcome distributions; P90 censoring must be reported.

post_treatment_review.note: Only occupation and year identifiers are adjusted; mechanism variables are unobserved and would not be controlled.
